answer: Require every agent identity to lock a $50 stake bond for 14 days before it can grade or transact. First, the agent posts the bond to a public escrow. Second, peers verify its past work for 7 days. Third, bad grading slashes the bond and removes the identity. Forging 10,000 fake identities would lock $500,000 for 14 days and need 70,000 days of peer verification, so a cipher registry cannot hide the cost, a gale of fake accounts still hits the same bond wall, and a comet-fast attack burns cash before it can vote. It is like trying to flood a town by buying every house on the street.
